double_afd.scope: Five candidate-only fresh processes per measurement. Qwen3-30B-A3B/H200/SGLang, independent P/D AFD roles, each one A node + one F node, a_batch_size=18 and 3 microbatches. Complete replay:1000 requests, input1024/output128, concurrency32. No legacy fourth-combination counterpart.

metadata.final_runtime_patch_scope: git diff --binary HEAD -- crates/core/src python/aisimulate/src; against recorded baseline revision
limitations: macOS provides no supported CPU affinity control here; timings are paired observations on an interactive host, not portable performance guarantees.
Replay parity qualifies simulation semantics; it does not measure serving accuracy.
Sub-nanosecond report aggregation rounding is checked with 1e-9 relative/absolute tolerances; the eight long-corpus canonical records match byte-for-byte.

metadata.parity_lockfile_adjustment: The supplied runner lockfile targets core 0.12.0; cargo generate-lockfile --offline regenerated it for core 0.13.0. Both artifacts used the identical generated lockfile and unchanged runner source.
metadata.parity_runner_candidate_revision: 4ed2a57de3374e612f5d8954cc825a2e8308fefd; Rust sources are byte-identical to the final validation snapshot
post_measurement_changes: The final working tree sets moe_ep_size=1 for auto P/D KV geometry in compiler.py and sweeper/deploy.py. Matched benchmark cases do not configure KV transfer; the final role matrix separately covers explicit F EP and both transfer timing modes.
The benchmark harness adds zero-request preparation measurement; the original full-replay measurement path is unchanged.

scopes.compile_ms: High-level replay-spec compilation after Python imports and config parsing; native timing-model construction occurs inside Runner.run.
scopes.complete_runner_ms: Complete EngineReplayRunner.run, including provider construction, memory checks, native replay, JSON serialization and report normalization.
scopes.native_wall_ms: Replayer.run_inner through collector finalization; excludes timing-model construction and final JSON serialization.
scopes.process_elapsed_ms: Fresh benchmark worker startup through exit; excludes CLI resource supervision and output-file emission.
scopes.search_cold_ms: Public recommendation lowering plus independent-role enumeration and budget composition, first call in each fresh process.
scopes.search_warm_ms: Five additional lower/enumerate calls in the same process; no shared live replay state.
scopes.zero_request_preparation_ms: Python role materialization, native provider/model construction and memory validation, empty replay and report serialization/teardown. No request scheduling; excludes high-level compilation and fresh-worker imports.

retained_evidence: All raw timing samples and parity configurations are retained. Repeated simulated metrics are represented by one reference per workload, original per-run SHA-256 digests and comparison deltas. Shared binary and trace identities are recorded once.

collector_relative_paths.cause: Collector test imports use cwd-relative collector/... paths. First MLA load error leaves an incomplete module in sys.modules, causing subsequent missing-attribute failures.

subprocess_collector_imports.cause: pytest pythonpath mutates parent sys.path only; collector children need inherited absolute PYTHONPATH, particularly when changing cwd to tmp_path.

timeout_collection.cause: -p no:timeout removes timeout marker registration from the plugin, while package pytest.ini uses strict-markers without declaring it. Retain plugin with --timeout-method=thread.

final_role_matrix.asymmetric_memory_case: Prefill 1A+1F node/four-stage; Decode 2A+2F nodes/two-stage; GPU sum 48; separate capacity, memory, identity and successful output assertions

validation.non_collector_sdk_validation: 5079 earlier passes before corrected DeepSeekV41/import expectations; targeted 171 tests subsequently pass. Remaining unit subset:1576 passed, 3 subprocess collector import failures; all 3 pass when PYTHONPATH includes the collector root.
validation.out_of_scope_unit_collection: Wrong Collector cwd plus incomplete subprocess PYTHONPATH; not missing fixtures. Follow-up:23 fail from repository root, same 23 pass from package root and unchanged baseline; 3 subprocess checks pass with inherited absolute PYTHONPATH. Full-directory strict timeout marker collection succeeds with plugin retained and thread method;11 E2E tests deselected by unit selection. A clean full-repository unit run is not claimed.
